reviews.title: Quiet, Great-Looking Fans with Excellent RGB Control
reviews.comment: The Lian Li UNI Fan SL-Infinity 120mm fans are very quiet and look fantastic once installed. The build quality feels solid, and the RGB lighting is bright, smooth, and evenly diffused. The Lian Li software gives you complete control over the RGB effects, making it easy to customize the lighting to match your setup. Installation was straightforward thanks to the UNI fan design, which helps reduce cable clutter. Overall, these fans perform well, run quietly, and add a great visual upgrade to a PC build. If you’re looking for quiet fans with excellent RGB customization and a clean install, these are a great choice.
reviews.author: Eric Espinoza

reviews.title: Awesome PC Fans
reviews.comment: Awesome fans with the bright rgb and infinity window on the sides looks super dope. You’re able to change the speed of the fans and the daisy chain makes it super easy to setup with little wires so that’s a plus and they’re very durable and quality is amazing. If you have the money to spend on a new build you won’t regret choosing these as they look amazing and cool your PC very well.
reviews.author: rosa diaz

reviews.title: These fans are easy to snap together, easy to install, and look fantastic. 10/10
reviews.comment: Built a system with these fans and it came out fantastic. The edge infinity mirrors (which are lit), the led lines around the fans, and the fans themselves just have a pretty amazing look, and the L Connect 3 software has a vast number of patterns and effects you can set up. I noticed also that the fans retain their last lighting pattern when you reset the computer, which is a nice bonus. I threw in some Strimmer cable lights because, hey what the heck. Why not? And the case was an RGB 011 so the fan lights and the case lights were nicely synchronized (did have to figure out that I had to press the case light "mode" button for 3 seconds to set it to LConnect 3 mode). Gotta say after this experience my go to company is going to be Lian-Li. Really great experience and their stuff just worked great and looked terrific.
reviews.author: BenjC

reviews.author: Mosquito slayer

reviews.title: Perfect for a high-performance Push-Pull radiator setup!
reviews.comment: I bought this triple pack of Lian Li SL-Infinity fans because I wanted to run a double row of fans on my water cooling radiator. The daisy-chain "Uni Fan" design is a lifesaver for this it makes the cable management so much cleaner since you only have one set of wires for all the fans in a row. The infinity mirror look is amazing, but more importantly, they move a lot of air and keep my temperatures very low. Even with a double layer of fans, they remain relatively quiet. If you are doing a high-end liquid cooled build and want the best combination of performance and aesthetics, these are the fans to get.
reviews.author: Alex
